h1: Phufah Resort Nong Bua Lamphu — a garden resort with a water-slide pool and easy-on-the-wallet rooms
intro: If you want a Nong Bua Lamphu stay with a pool for the kids to splash in, gardens to wander and roomy quarters at a few-hundred-baht price point, Phufah Resort is a name locals and road-trippers reach for · It's a garden resort of around 44 rooms on the edge of town in Lamphu subdistrict, with bungalows, terraced rooms, standalone houses and even private-pool villas · What reviews agree on is spacious clean rooms, a large outdoor pool with a water slide, and a quiet garden setting · There's free parking plus banquet/seminar halls for group events · From approx. ฿400/night · Real guest reviews suggest it suits families, seminar groups and self-drive travellers who want space over a central location.

body.html: Phufah Resort (locals just call it Phufah) is a garden resort of around 44 rooms at 130 Moo 2, Lamphu subdistrict, Mueang district, on the outskirts of Nong Bua Lamphu town · The resort is a spread of single-storey blocks set across wide garden grounds, with several room styles to choose from — bungalows, terraced rooms, standalone houses, and pool villas with a private pool · Unlike the in-town tower hotels, it offers space to stroll, parking right in front of your room and a swimming pool, which makes it a good fit for anyone who wants privacy and room to breathe rather than a downtown address.

The most talked-about feature is the large outdoor pool with a water slide, which makes this a popular pick for families with children · There are also pool-villa rooms with a private pool for guests who want full privacy · Many reviews say the rooms are larger than expected and clean, with comfortable beds; every room has air-con, an en-suite bathroom and free Wi-Fi · They're simple resort-style rooms that prioritise space and comfort over designer finishes.
"The room was bigger than the price suggested, the kids spent all day on the pool slide, and the gardens around were quiet and pleasant — a great spot for the whole family."

The location sits on the outskirts of Nong Bua Lamphu in Lamphu subdistrict · You can drive into town and the market in just a few minutes, while the resort itself sits in a quiet garden zone away from the busy main road · There's free on-site parking, very handy for self-drive travellers or for a one-night break on an Isan road trip · Nong Bua Lamphu town is around 45–48 km from Udon Thani city and roughly 49 km from Udon Thani Airport, which is why many people use Phufah as a stop when driving through the upper Isan region.

Beyond rooms and the pool, Phufah has an on-site restaurant, 24-hour reception and banquet/seminar halls, making it a popular choice for weddings, parties and group meetings in the province · If you're arriving as a large group or hosting an event, the garden grounds and generous parking handle it comfortably · The overall feel is a friendly, locally run resort that leans into value and usable space rather than big-chain service.

To be straight about it, based on real guest reviews: the limitations people mention are that the entrance road is potholed in places and needs careful driving, especially after rain · some reviews note there are few power outlets in the rooms, so if you're travelling in a group with lots of gadgets you may want to bring a power strip · and a few guests felt staff attentiveness was uneven at times · These are the trade-offs that come with the friendly price and the resort's fairly large footprint; if you expect big-chain standards, set expectations accordingly.

In short, if you want a garden resort on the edge of Nong Bua Lamphu with a pool the kids can enjoy, spacious rooms, quiet gardens and easy parking at a few-hundred-baht price — Phufah Resort lands nicely · An average score of around 7.8 from real reviews reflects it well: strong on space, pool and value, with a few things to allow for around the entrance road and service · It works for families with children, seminar groups, or self-drive travellers who want room to spread out over a central location.

A tip from following the reviews here: if you're travelling with kids and want easy pool access, ask for a room near the pool or request a pool-view room when booking, and for maximum privacy look at the pool-villa rooms with their own pool · On long weekends or when a party/seminar is on site, rooms fill quickly and there can be event noise — book ahead and pick a free-cancellation rate if your plans aren't firm · And take the entrance road slowly, as some sections are potholed.

honestSummary: Phufah Resort is a solid pick for anyone who wants a garden resort on the outskirts of Nong Bua Lamphu with a water-slide pool, spacious rooms and easy parking at a few-hundred-baht price — great for families with kids, seminar groups and self-drive travellers · Just accept that the entrance road is potholed in places, in-room outlets are limited, and the location is out of town.
honestChecks: If you want to stay in the centre and walk to food — this is on the town outskirts in Lamphu, so you'll drive into the centre for a varied dinner → for a central base, look at Mueang Nang Thani Grand or Nong Bua Lamphu Signature

faqTitle: FAQ — Phufah Resort Nong Bua Lamphu

faq.q: Where is Phufah Resort in Nong Bua Lamphu, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Phufah Resort is at 130 Moo 2, Lamphu subdistrict, Mueang district, on the outskirts of Nong Bua Lamphu town · It's about 5 km from town and the market, roughly a 10–12 minute drive · Wat Tham Klong Phen is around 13 km away · Udon Thani city is about 46 km and Udon Thani Airport about 49 km · The resort itself sits in a quiet garden zone.

faq.q: How much does Phufah Resort cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. ฿400/night for a standard room · There are double rooms, family rooms/standalone houses, and pool villas with a private pool at around ฿1,500 · Prices vary by room type and season, so compare Agoda and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Does Phufah Resort have a pool, and is it good for kids?
faq.a: Yes — there's a large outdoor pool with a water slide, the feature families with children love most · There are also pool-villa rooms with a private pool for guests who want privacy · It's a good fit for families who want the kids to swim and room to roam in the gardens.

faq.q: Who is Phufah Resort best for?
faq.a: It's best for families with kids, seminar groups and self-drive travellers who want space and a pool at a few-hundred-baht price · There are banquet/seminar halls for group events · It's less ideal for those who want to stay in the centre and walk to food, or who expect big-chain hotel standards.

faq.q: Does Phufah Resort have parking and a restaurant?
faq.a: Yes — there's free on-site parking, handy for self-drive travellers, and an on-site restaurant · Reception is open 24 hours · Every room has air-con, an en-suite bathroom and free Wi-Fi.

faq.q: Anything to watch out for before booking Phufah Resort?
faq.a: Per real guest reviews, the entrance road is potholed in places, so drive in slowly, especially after rain · Rooms have few power outlets, so bring a power strip if you're in a group · And during on-site parties/seminars it can get noisy and busy, so ask about the schedule if you want a quiet stay.
